name: bridge-gui-main
description: XRift Bridge の管理画面（Electrobun によるデスクトップ GUI。段1スパイク）。

scripts.gui:prepare: vp run -F "bridge-plugin-text..." -F "bridge-plugin-diagnostic..." -F "bridge-plugin-udp..." build && hutch electrobun prepare
scripts.gui:build:dev: pnpm stage:plugins && cross-env BRIDGE_GUI_UI_DIR=src/mainview-dist/dev hutch electrobun build --env=dev
scripts.gui:run: pnpm --filter bridge-gui-ui ng:build:dev && pnpm stage:ui dev && pnpm gui:prepare && pnpm stage:plugins && cross-env BRIDGE_GUI_UI_DIR=src/mainview-dist/dev hutch electrobun build --env=dev && hutch electrobun run
scripts.gui:run:console: pnpm --filter bridge-gui-ui ng:build:dev && pnpm stage:ui dev && pnpm gui:prepare && pnpm stage:plugins && cross-env BRIDGE_GUI_UI_DIR=src/mainview-dist/dev hutch electrobun build --env=dev && cross-env BRIDGE_GUI_NG_DEBUG=1 BRIDGE_GUI_DEV_CONSOLE=1 hutch electrobun run
scripts.gui:build: pnpm --filter bridge-gui-ui ng:build:prod && pnpm stage:ui prod && pnpm gui:prepare && pnpm stage:plugins && cross-env BRIDGE_GUI_UI_DIR=src/mainview-dist/prod hutch run build
